name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: IFRS/XBRL, ISSB/ESRS, PCAOB and professional accounting guidance with open research replication workflows; skills and offline research checkers only.

interface.longDescription: Research and educational accounting, XBRL/ISSB/ESRS, PCAOB and professional-body guidance. Includes original skills and offline registry-based research and verification controls for public EDGAR, scholarly theses and open replication repositories; no live GitHub/Kaggle/HF/SSRN/SEC MCP, external Co-Scientist/AlphaEvolve access or licensed professional manuals are included. No professional certification, audit opinion or guaranteed replication result.
defaultPrompt: Compare ACCA, AICPA CPA, IIA CIA, IMA CMA and ACFE CFE guidance for a fictional case, citing the actual official source.
Compare public PwC, EY, KPMG and Deloitte IFRS guidance with the governing standard for the requested year.
Find FT50/AJG4 accounting studies and identify any actually available open replication code, dataset licences and linked theses.

publication.release_notes: V3.4 adds 11 professional bodies and open research skills, offline regulatory routing and multi-agent reviewer planning; no new remote integrations.
